confirmed.quote: The world’s largest ⁠crude oil exporter has increased its use of the 745-mile (1,200km) pipeline running across the Arabian peninsula, which links Abqaiq, near the Gulf, to the port of Yanbu, on the Red Sea, since the US-Israeli war against Iran began.
confirmed.correction: The pipeline's eastern end is Abqaiq (بقيق in Arabic), not a place called 'أبقاع'.

confirmed.quote: It said the kingdom “reserves the right to take all necessary measures to protect its sovereignty, its security, its facilities” and its people.
confirmed.correction: The statement says the kingdom, not the King, reserves the right to take all necessary measures.
